XenotypeDef.label: Half-Ghoul
XenotypeDef.description: An escaped horrifying laboratory experiment to give intelligence to ghouls. It seems they have not become particularly smart, but they have learned some features. Half-Ghouls are very strong in close combat, do not experience pain and have good regeneration, which makes them excellent fighters in close combat.
